newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Helicopter says longterm outlook positive.
newsitem.headline: Helicopter says longterm outlook positive.

text.p: New Zealand tourism group The Helicopter Line Ltd on Thursday said earnings before tax and depreciation for all operations were gradually improving as emphasis was placed on increased passenger numbers and yields and on greater efficiency.
"It is unlikely any significant improvement in tourist arrivals will be seen before the first half of 1997, however, the long term outlook remains positive," the company said in a statement.
It said all of the group's activities were impacted by increased competition and rate cutting. "This is particularly evident where there are few barriers to entry."
